components.name: Rock pillar/platform seat
components.function: Need rock-to-platform footings, open arcade/corner hosts, platform edge/rail segments, rope-bridge anchor/deck details and stair-ascent joins. Do not repurpose porcelain bridge deck as rope bridge. Hanging vines and sparse canopy pockets; roosting birds/butterflies proposed. Elevation/access/collision unresolved. Provide missing isolated hosts and join views.
components.construction: One isolated rock pillar/platform seat matching the supplied building, its roof/arch/wall silhouette and local materials. Show front and interior/rear/underside contact, not a complete building scene. Actual open column galleries and holes stay open. Extend hidden depth only enough to form a joinable section; no palace-wide plan or added unrelated tower.
components.attachment_face: Underside/root to ground or declared host; keep true openings clear
components.semantic_front: Main visible face +Y and Zup; sides are actual thickness, not flattened painting
components.design_basis: Visible source vocabulary with missing construction views or new habitat forms; metrics and hidden surfaces proposed
